captures.description: THE ARCHIVE, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-31: 'The Irish Left Archive is a digital project and online repository dedicated to collecting, preserving, and sharing material related to left-wing politics, activism, and history in Ireland.' Digital collection; timeline; scope; personal accounts; the podcast. Four cards: the archive, Spotify, Pocket Casts, mastodon.online.

atoms.evidence: The Irish Left Archive is a digital project and online repository
dedicated to collecting, preserving, and sharing material related to left-wing politics, activism, and history in Ireland.
Holds over 1,200 documents, hundreds of organizations, publications, profiles, and collections
Collects first-hand observations and reminiscences from activists and participants in Irish left movements.
Freely accessible documents, manifestos, pamphlets, and publications
